assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent animated character sprite atlas for Kasi Quest, a polished side-scrolling rooftop action game. Create ONE square 1024x1024 RGBA sprite sheet containing exactly 20 separated full-body poses of ONE consistent human Rooftop Runner, arranged in exactly 4 columns and 5 rows. Subject: adult athletic Black woman with short curly hair, orange cropped sports jacket, dark teal trousers, cyan sneakers, fingerless gloves and a small glowing wrist gadget. Human face clearly visible, no helmet, no robot body. Compact stylized 3D game rendering with readable chunky proportions, dark outlines, cool purple/cyan rim light matching a futuristic rooftop game. Every pose faces RIGHT, strict side-view/very slight three-quarter side, consistent clothing, scale and identity. Row 1: four quiet idle/breathing poses. Row 2: four distinctly different consecutive running gait poses, alternating feet and arm swing. Row 3: four anticipation poses preparing a forward dash, progressively crouching and leaning. Row 4: first two poses a forward dash/short palm strike with wrist gadget, last two poses recoiling from a hit. Row 5: four defeat poses progressing from buckled knees, crouch, falling sideways, lying down naturally shorter. Each cell 256x204, generous transparent gutters; entire character INCLUDING hair, hands, feet and gadget fits in its own cell. Normal standing characters approx 150 pixels tall, feet share a baseline in each row; collapsed poses naturally shorter. No objects disconnected from the body. GENUINE transparent empty background, no floor, no ground shadows, no gradient, no checkerboard pixels, no glowing beams or large effects. No text, no numbers, no borders, no labels, no watermark. This is production animation art, not a character poster.
